templates.why_chosen: A single concrete example (replicas 2 to 3, highlighted red) traces through the reconciliation chain, where small circular reload icons inside the Statefulset and Volume controllers stand in for repeating loops.
templates.what_to_learn: Trace one concrete input change (the red-highlighted replica diff) all the way through the system, and use a small self-loop icon inside a controller box to mean 'reconciles repeatedly' instead of a full drawn cycle; but this figure's ellipsis boxes elide most of the actual loop, so show at least one full traversal too.
